answer: Each new agent must anchor its identity with a verifiable delay function: a 24-hour sequential computation that cannot be parallelized, so extra GPUs do not help. Like water carving karst, only elapsed time does the work. A farm wanting 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 machines running a full day each, roughly $2,000 in cloud cost, and every identity must re-anchor monthly, so the attacker pays again forever while an honest agent pays a drop in the ocean.
